PYTHONPATH=host/src:consumer python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing, ValidationError
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema

class Child(Schema):
    value = fields.Integer()

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw, fields.Integer):
        f = cls(load_default=lambda: 12, dump_default=lambda: 34)
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == 12
        assert f.serialize('absent', {}) == 34
        assert f.deserialize(56) == 56
        assert f.serialize('present', {'present': 78}) == 78
        assert not f.metadata
        assert 'dump_default=' in repr(f) and 'load_default=' in repr(f)
        assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
        try:
            cls(required=True, load_default=0)
        except ValueError as e:
            assert 'load_default' in str(e)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('required accepted a load_default')
    c = fields.Constant('constant', load_default='ignored', dump_default='ignored')
    assert c.deserialize(missing) == c.deserialize('input') == 'constant'
    assert c.serialize('anything', {}) == 'constant'
    assert c.load_default == c.dump_default == 'constant'
    n = fields.Nested(Child, load_default=lambda: {'value': 12}, dump_default={'value': 34})
    assert n.deserialize(missing) == {'value': 12}
    assert n.deserialize({'value': '56'}) == {'value': 56}
    assert n.serialize('absent', {}) == {'value': 34}
    class Parent(Schema):
        number = fields.Integer(load_default=1, dump_default=2)
        child = fields.Nested(Child, dump_default={'value': 3})
        dynamic = fields.String(dump_default=lambda: 'dynamic')
        nullable = fields.Raw(load_default=None)
    p = Parent()
    assert p.load({}) == {'number': 1, 'nullable': None}
    assert p.dump({}) == {'number': 2, 'child': {'value': 3}, 'dynamic': 'dynamic'}
    properties = JSONSchema().dump(p)['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert properties['number']['default'] == 2
    assert properties['child']['default'] == {'value': 3}
    assert 'default' not in properties['dynamic']

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    f = fields.Raw(default=2, missing=1)
    assert f.default == 2 and f.missing == 1
    f.default = 4
    f.missing = 3
    assert f.serialize('absent', {}) == 4 and f.deserialize(missing) == 3
    assert len(caught) == 6
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    f = fields.Field(default=1, dump_default=2, missing=3, load_default=4)
    assert f.dump_default == 2 and f.load_default == 4
print('New API, legacy aliases, and warning-free consumer integration checks passed.')
PY
